answer: Who should control a shared budget for river gauges, orchard sensors and pearl inspections? Let agents allocate votes in direct proportion to deposits locked until the chosen purchases settle. The contract must track each deposited unit once and offer no voting bonus for opening an account. Splitting 90 units among 90 aliases still buys only 90 votes. To capture a majority, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough additional capital to outweigh honest deposits. This removes the advantage of multiplying identities, while leaving concentrated wealth a separate risk.
